name: Szamosszeg (Hungary)
description: White field with a serrated border of yellow and blue triangles, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Szamosszeg: a crowned blue shield with two white birds and reeds, within a green wreath, above a scroll inscribed SZAMOSSZEG.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
